reviews.review_title: I placed an order (8212466431475063) on…
reviews.review_text: I placed an order (8212466431475063) on July 8. On July 17th, it had yet to ship - and when I checked the details, the seller had moved the dispatch date forward - it was not scheduled to ship for 21 additional days. I cancelled the order and reordered the product from a reputable vendor. I woke up this morning to lies from the Ali seller - stating the order had been dispatched, but the tracking not uploaded, so they would do that now. The tracking clearly demonstrated that they dispatched *something* with a tracking number within hours of receiving my cancellation request. Having already ordered replacements from a reputable vendor (and knowing that this order will sit in an Ali sorting centre for a week) I have asked that this order be cancelled, in keeping with my request submitted well before dispatch. Instead, Ali support was very happy to tell me that my parcel was on the way, and that they understand the "anticipation" of waiting for an order. So perhaps there is a parcel on the way (full of things I no longer need) but more likely, I will have to wait out a 75 day clock to claim a refund when nothing arrives. I keep coming up against reasons to NEVER USE ALI AGAIN. One of these days, it will stick. But seriously - time and time again, the savings I realize by shopping here are clawed back by the fraud that is endemic on the site.

reviews.review_title: DO NOT USE THE ALIEXPRESS APP OR ONLINE…
reviews.review_text:
DO NOT USE THE ALIEXPRESS APP OR ONLINE SHOP – ESPECIALLY THE WALLET!

This is based on my own experience.

I returned some items and was refunded, but I chose to keep the refund in my AliExpress Wallet to use for future purchases.

Later, I ordered more items using that wallet credit. One order arrived broken, so I returned it but my refund was £0. I let it go because it was only a few pounds and I didn’t want the hassle.

Then another order arrived with the wrong item. I contacted customer service, provided screenshots and all the evidence they requested, but after everything, the representative (“Aria”) still told me I would receive a £0 refund.

The £22.69 I had originally been refunded and stored in my AliExpress Wallet, my own money, was effectively gone because I had used wallet credit to pay for the order.

So from my experience, once you use AliExpress Wallet credit to buy something, returning that item may result in a £0 refund, even if the item is faulty or incorrect.

I won’t be shopping with AliExpress again, and I’d strongly advise others to be very careful about using the wallet feature.

reviews.review_title: I have been ordering from Ali Express…
reviews.review_text:
I have been ordering from Ali Express for years. I know when I receive my packages I they get to be a little banged up, but the contents are great inside. I also wait some time to receive my items, and I have learned to deal with that. The sellers I purchase from, are great and I haven’t been able to find the same merchandise anywhere else, so I adapted and it works for me. What I can’t take is no regard for me as a customer and the money I spend. Their customer service is unhelpful and robotic. They use a logistics company called “ Cainio Express “ I don’t know if they have a new driver and he is just incompetent as well as there customer service. But, I need to receive the orders I place. The last like 17 items I have purchased, which I believe was broken down in about 6 packages were delivered to an unknown home. This has happened on n the past, but with items under $20 and I just let it go. Ali Express will not refund you when your package is delivered. They don’t care if it was sent to the wrong home. Nor, will they get you to a supervisor to rectify the situation. They don’t do that there. They will not refund or reship. They tell you to contact the logistics company. That was horrible. They they gave me a lost and stolen package pdf certificate and still denied my refund, why? This logistics company is not delivering the merchandise. Ali Express, Please do something about this, it’s a huge problem.  I received a reply for order numbers and additional information, for some reason there was a system glitch and I was unable to add the order numbers and my phone number. I have escalated cases and been denied refunds. I was told to submit information from the logistics company which I did for the first order and I was told to get more information. I have asked to speak with a supervisor or someone who can help several times and told by customer service there was no additional help and they were very rude to me. How can I get someone to help me? This has been like over 11 items already delivered to the wrong address, with no help from logistics and they keep delivering to the same house because I can see it in the photos they provide. 
Thank you for replying, I have placed about 3 orders this week and I am afraid of Cainio getting assigned to my orders. Your customer service told me they were blocked from picking up my packages, and I would receive an email confirmation. I never did, and I called back the next rep told me that I would have to reach out to each seller individually. I have done that, they have no say on who the packages get assigned to. Please help me. I need my packages.
